newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end higher amid volatility.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end higher amid volatility.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed higher Thursday amid volatility ahead of options expiry as local prices firmed in line with a late recovery on Wall Street, which reversed sharp losses to end slightly higher, brokers said.
"The Dow was up in the afternoon and we followed," said a local dealer at local Crefisul brokerage.
The Sao Paulo bolsa's Bovespa index of 47 most-traded shares rose 0.45 percent to end at 11,904 points Thursday on volume of 785.6 million reais ($724 million).
